desc:
WHIPPED CREAM ICING - Experience the sumptuous Betty Crocker Whipped Cream Frosting - a delicious, creamy treat that will take your desserts to new heights.

PERFECT FOR EVERY Dessert: This 12oz tin is filled with airy, lightweight and fluffy instant icing perfect for spreading on cakes, cupcakes and cookies.

MAKE EVERY BITE MEMORABLE - Enhance your baking creations with the benefits of whipped cream, adding a touch of elegance and softness to every bite. Let yourself be tempted by the velvety softness that melts in your mouth, creating moments of pure happiness.

Fast, easy and gluten free: just open the can, spread the light cream and enjoy. Enjoy delicious gluten-free icing on your favorite desserts.

MADE WITH LOVE - The whipping cream has been designed with precision and care, making it the perfect companion for all your sweet activities.
features:
Features

Whipped and Airy Texture

Light, fluffy, and easy to spread—gives cakes and cupcakes a smooth, professional finish.

Ready-to-Use Convenience

No mixing or prep needed. Open the can and spread directly—perfect for quick desserts.

Gluten-Free and Kosher Certified

Suitable for those with gluten sensitivities or dietary restrictions.

Artificially Flavored Butter-Cream

Offers a sweet, buttery flavor without real butter, ideal for long shelf life.

Shelf-Stable

Does not require refrigeration before opening; stores well in the pantry.

Benefits

Time-Saving

Great for busy bakers—skip the mess and effort of making frosting from scratch.

Consistent Results

Smooth texture spreads evenly, making decorating easy even for beginners.

Customizable

Can be tinted with food coloring or topped with sprinkles, fruits, or other decorations.

Cost-Effective

Budget-friendly compared to homemade or bakery frosting options.

Positive User Experience

Users find it tasty, easy to apply, and reliable for everyday baking needs.
ingredients:
Main Ingredients: Sugar, palm oil, water, corn syrup, corn starch

Less than 2% of: Monoglycerides, cellulose gel, cellulose gum, salt, polysorbate 80, sodium acid pyrophosphate, citric acid, natural and artificial flavors, artificial colors (including Yellow 5 and Yellow 6)

Preservative: Potassium sorbate

Allergen Note: May contain milk ingredients
